title: Decide gf2-algebra crate boundary against gf2-core
description:
## Context The new `gf2-algebra` crate (per epic ae82bd73) hosts permanent algorithms and packed small-prime field representations. This issue settles which types live where: - What stays in `gf2-core`: bedrock primitives only (`FiniteField`, `Fp

`, `BitVec`, `BitMatrix`, `Fp

::*`). - What moves into `gf2-algebra`: `PackedField` trait, `Bipedal3`/`Bipedal5`/`Bipedal7` packed types, `permanent_*` algorithms, Gray-code enumerator, parallel and GPU dispatch glue. - What lives in `gf2-kernels-simd`: SIMD bipedal kernels (added in W3 by separate issue). - What lives in `gf2-kernels-hip`: GPU permanent kernels (added in W5 by separate issue). Output: a short decision doc in `dev/plans/d1a_gf2_algebra_boundary.md` (≤ 200 lines) listing every public type the epic introduces and naming its home crate, plus the dependency-direction graph. ## Success Criteria 1. [hard] Decision doc lands in `dev/plans/`, attached to this issue via `jit doc add`. 2. [hard] No circular crate dependencies are proposed; `gf2-algebra → gf2-core` is the only forward edge required. 3. [hard] The doc enumerates every public type the linked epic design doc mentions and assigns each to exactly one crate. 4. [hard] The doc explicitly justifies why bipedal types do not live in `gf2-core` (they are not field elements; they pack many F₃ elements per word).
